approved_scope: Remediate every child review v1 finding without changing the approved M4.2 application abstractions or performing a provider write.

design_preflight.interface: WriteProposalWorkflow.handle(TypedWriteCommand, WorkspacePrincipal, ActorContext) plus ToolActionStore and Workspace-scoped proposal HTTP routes
current_responsibilities: immutable proposal construction and canonical intent binding
human approve/reject policy and decision CAS
PostgreSQL proposal, decision and append-only audit persistence
HTTP authentication, Workspace authorization and safe projection mapping
design_preflight.new_responsibility: Make the existing seams enforce fail-closed request-scoped actor authority, canonical-json-v1 provenance, exact compatibility reasons, complete target fingerprinting and database lifecycle/immutability contracts.
design_preflight.rationale: proposals.py is 579 lines and owns both typed value contracts and workflow behavior. Extracting cohesive proposal value/canonical/compatibility contracts keeps the workflow deep and below the 400-line source trigger without adding a framework.

confirmed_test_seams.authority: Issue #76, locked guide m4-76-write-proposal-v3 and the approved M4 design already confirm these seams.
seams: real integrity-protected proposal target verifier after #75 integration

tdd_slices.behavior: No global authenticated-human fallback; proposal actor and approval authority are request-scoped and fail closed.
tdd_slices.first_red_test: Default app exposes no proposal route and unauthorized human/model/system decisions create no decision.

tdd_slices.behavior: Title/description and every provenance digest implement canonical-json-v1, exact whitespace/scalar bounds and surrogate rejection.
tdd_slices.first_red_test: Leading/trailing whitespace and surrogate matrices fail while a 10000-scalar description succeeds.

tdd_slices.behavior: Typed CompatibilityCheckerV1 emits exact closed mismatch reasons; resolver failure is stale; default execution authorization denies.
tdd_slices.first_red_test: Approved projection matrix for capability/binding/policy identity/version/digest, resolver failure and temporary authority denial.

tdd_slices.behavior: Proposal target claims and provider request fingerprint bind reference ID, resource kind, resource identity/claims digests, exact capability/binding and parameters.
tdd_slices.first_red_test: Independent literal fingerprint oracle changes for every target claim and excludes policy/lease/logical ID.

tdd_slices.behavior: PostgreSQL persists proposal/approval authority provenance and protects expiry, material fields, lifecycle, decisions and audit with closed constraints.
tdd_slices.first_red_test: Mutation matrix and invalid direct SQL lifecycle/decision rows fail at the database boundary.

tdd_slices.behavior: A real concurrent PostgreSQL approve/reject race has one deterministic atomic winner and one persisted loser projection.
tdd_slices.first_red_test: Barrier-released approve and reject calls through separate transactions.

tdd_slices.behavior: The production proposal target verifier uses the accepted #75 integrity/reference seams; malformed/MAC/key/expiry/claim/store matrices fail before persistence.
tdd_slices.first_red_test: Locked TC-02 reference matrix after reconciling #76 with integrated #75.
tdd_slices.dependency: #75 must be accepted and integrated before this slice and final M4.2 acceptance.

constraints: No provider write or execution/reconciliation behavior in #76.
Do not claim TC-02 target-reference coverage using an always-accepting fake.
Do not run PostgreSQL test suites concurrently.
Rerun locked guide v3 only after reconciliation with the accepted #75 integration head.
